claims.claim: Hill(ESEM 2026)以 119 个开源仓库、88,052 个已合并非 bot PR(原始 100,247,剔除 12,195 bot PR;采集 2026-03-28~04-03,365 天回看,约 2025-04~2026-04)检验 5 条由 SDD 厂商宣传语推出的假设,5 条均不成立。
claims.quote: We test five hypotheses derived from SDD vendor claims against 88,052 pull requests across 119 open-source repositories.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: Dagstuhl PDF 主机被本会话网络策略拦截,全文取自作者 GitHub 仓库的 camera-ready LaTeX 源(2026-07-27);摘要数字与第三方读已发表 PDF 的转述(mattbutlerengineering/ai-tooling PR#731)一致。tex 内 ArticleNo=83、出版 URL 为 .84,系编辑编号差。 单作者、独立研究者(tex 署名 'Independent Researcher, Germany');无资助/利益冲突声明。作者另有书《The Delivery Gap》与 'cost per accepted change' 指标项目(GitHub 公开仓库),属非财务立场利益。

claims.claim: Hill 的「spec'd」处理变量实际几乎全是 issue/ticket 引用:24,298/88,052(27.6%)PR 被判为 spec'd,其中 97.5% 由 issue 号/issue URL/ticket ID 触发,PR 正文内结构化需求段仅 24 个(0.1%)。作者自述测的是「issue 与 ticket 引用存在性」,不是 SDD 工具产出。
claims.quote: 97.5\% of spec'd PRs are identified by a reference to a tracking issue or ticket, while structured requirements text written directly into the PR body accounts for 24 PRs. Whatever else this measure captures, in practice it measures \emph{issue- and ticket-reference presence}.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 本线用作者公开 master-prs.csv 复跑:非 bot 88,052、spec'd 24,298(27.6%)、#N 11,348、GitHub issue URL 7,252、外部文档 URL 561、模板段 24,与论文表 2 逐项吻合(现场核验)。这是本研究最大的构念效度缺口:它检验的是 T1 级「有工单」而非 Spec Kit/Kiro 工作流。

claims.claim: 样本中没有任何仓库提交 SDD 工具产出:全部 100,247 个 PR 的标题/描述/改动路径中 .specify/、.speckit/、.kiro/、spec-kit 零命中;119 仓库默认分支文件树审计(2026-04 人工、2026-07 程序化)也为零。因此「采用 SDD 工具是否降缺陷」在该样本中不可检验。
claims.quote: SDD tool adoption itself remains untested: no repository in the sample commits such output.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 引用本论文时最容易被误读的点:不能写成「SDD 不降缺陷」,只能写成「开源 PR 中的规格工件(主要是工单引用)与缺陷无关」。

claims.claim: H1(规格→缺陷)主估计为倾向得分匹配:17,375 对匹配 PR,spec'd 缺陷引入率 14.7% vs 未 spec'd 15.2%,差 −0.6pp,p=0.133(16 个协变量平衡),无差异。缺陷由基本 SZZ 回溯,仅覆盖 103/119 仓库。
claims.quote: Across 17,375 matched pairs, spec'd PRs introduce defects at 14.7\% against 15.2\% for their unspec'd matches, a difference of $-0.6$pp ($p = 0.133$): matching eliminates the raw association entirely.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 未报告匹配估计的置信区间;p 值为名义值(作者自承样本量非预设、可选停止)。SZZ 基本版误归因率 46–71%(da Costa 2017),作者以匹配+非 SZZ 的返工指标作主证据。

claims.claim: 原始(未调整)关联方向与 SDD 宣称相反:spec'd PR 引入缺陷的 OR=1.20(p<0.001)、被返工 OR=1.18;作者内固定效应+规模控制下缺陷 +1.4pp [+0.5,+2.4](p=0.003);加入 JIT 风险特征后降 55% 且不显著(p=0.229)。作者解释为适应证混杂:开发者给最难的活写 spec。
claims.quote: This is \emph{confounding by indication} -- developers write specs for their hardest work, and harder work produces more defects.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: spec'd PR 新增行数 1.8×、触及文件年龄 2.3×、作者先前提交中位数 64 vs 116。注意 SSRN 预印本(2026-04)把「spec'd PR 引入更多缺陷」作为摘要头条,ESEM 终稿按审稿条件改为「匹配后无差异」——同一数据、头条方向措辞改变。

claims.claim: H2(规格→返工)无保护效应:作者内 +1.2pp [+0.5,+1.9](p=0.001,方向为更多返工,约每 83 个 PR 多 1 次返工);匹配后 +0.5pp(p=0.146,19,648 对)。返工定义:30 天内任何人提交触及重叠文件、且标题/描述含 fix/revert/hotfix/regression 等词的后续 PR(排除被 >30% PR 触及的高频文件);13.4% PR 被判返工。
claims.quote: The within-author estimate is in the wrong direction -- the same author's spec'd PRs have a 1.2 percentage-point higher rework rate than their unspec'd PRs ($p = 0.001$), about one extra rework event per 83 PRs -- and matching on task complexity removes the difference rather than reversing it ($+0.5$pp, $p = 0.146$).
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 返工指标为关键词+文件重叠启发式,未报告人工校验精度/召回;作者称不依赖 SZZ 故作主证据。

claims.claim: H3/H4(规格质量→缺陷/返工)不成立:质量分由 Claude Haiku 按 7 维量表打分(0–100),25,209 PR 被评分;作者内估计缺陷系数 −0.0003(95% CI [−0.0007,+0.0001],p=0.164,即 +10 分质量对应约 −0.3pp),返工 p=0.860。作者自定 H3/H4 为探索性。
claims.quote: Specification quality predicts neither defects ($p = 0.164$) nor rework ($p = 0.860$)
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: LLM 评分与人工评分一致性仅中等:38 个 PR 分层样本,Spearman ρ=0.42;验收标准维度 ρ=0.17、数据契约 0.19、错误状态 0.22。量表衡量「形式完整性」而非「功能正确性」。38 例人工校验样本很小。

claims.claim: H5(规格约束 AI 改动范围)不成立:用 5,989 个 AI 标记 PR(占 6.8%),spec×AI 交互项 +0.000(95% CI [−0.101,+0.102],p=0.997,来自 366 名有处理变异的作者);有 spec 的 PR 改动更大(AI +12.0%、人 +14.0%)。
claims.quote: The spec $\times$ AI interaction is $+0.000$ (95\% CI $[-0.101, +0.102]$, $p = 0.997$, identified from 366 authors).
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: AI 标记分类器精度 98.8%、召回仅 24.2%(537 个自报披露 PR 校验),约 3/4 AI 辅助工作不可见;CI 宽度 ±0.1 log-churn(约 ±10%),不算「紧」。

claims.claim: 唯一方向符合 SDD 宣称的子组:在「未检测到 AI 使用」的仓库(3,562 PR)中,spec 与返工减少 −3.3pp 相关(名义 p=0.014),但为 6 个子组检验之一,未过 Bonferroni 阈值 α=0.0083。
claims.quote: One subgroup runs the other way -- in repositories with no detected AI use, specifications are associated with less rework ($-3.3$pp, $p = 0.014$) -- but it is one of six subgroup tests and does not survive correction for multiple comparisons.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 正反双方都可能挑这一条:反方会忽略,正方会放大。成文须带「未过多重比较校正」。

claims.claim: Hill 自承抽样为目的性分层、刻意富集强规格实践仓库,且样本量未预设:仓库在「未见效应」时持续追加,至 119 个、零结果稳定后停止;所有分析为事后分析,未预注册。
claims.quote: Repositories were added while no effect was evident, and collection stopped at 119 once the null appeared stable across the checks in \cref{sec:robustness}.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 作者论证可选停止主要膨胀假阳性而非假阴性;但「看到零结果稳定才停」同样意味着数据驱动停止,对零结论也非完全中性(方法学审计席应审)。两波仓库:43(按 issue 链接率分层 8/12/6/3 + 14 个 AI 层)+77(33 强流程/24 弱/20 重度 AI)−1 无数据=119。

claims.claim: 外部效度:119 个仓库全部为开源,而 SDD 工具主要面向商业团队;多数 PR 早于普遍的 agentic 编码;作者明言结果不应外推到商业开发,也不能排除「spec 作为 agent 输入、端到端由 agent 实现」的工作流表现不同。
claims.quote: Our results speak to open-source pull request workflows and should not be extrapolated to commercial development.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)

claims.claim: 同行评审轨迹:据作者仓库的修订计划,ESEM 结果为有条件接收;一位审稿人(#26A)建议拒稿,被元审稿(#26D)推翻;五项接收条件包括「围绕实际测量物重新定框」「降低对 SZZ 的依赖」「弱化零 AI 子组」「补充抽样框」。头条从「spec'd PR 引入更多缺陷 +1.4pp」改为 PSM 主估计的完全零结果。
claims.quote: **Status:** conditional accept. #26A recommended reject; the meta-review (#26D) overrode it.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, ESEM Revision Plan — Conditional Accept (Review #26D), 作者 GitHub 仓库
claims.notes: 作者自存文件,非会议官方审稿记录;发表于 SEIP(Software Engineering in Practice)轨道而非研究轨道。

claims.claim: SSRN 工作论文版(2026-04)与 ESEM 终稿同数据但头条不同:预印本摘要写「spec'd PR 引入更多而非更少缺陷」,终稿改为匹配后「无法区分」。
claims.quote: Spec’d PRs introduce more defects, not fewer — developers spec their hardest work, and hard work produces defects (confounding by indication).
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026-04, Does Spec-Driven Development Reduce Defects? An Empirical Test of Industry Claims Across 119 Open-Source Repositories, SSRN Working Paper(PDF 取自作者仓库 ssrn-sdd-null-result.pdf)
claims.notes: 二手搜索摘要称预印本用 100,247 PR——不准确:预印本摘要同为 88,052(100,247 是剔 bot 前)。引用时只用 ESEM 终稿口径。

claims.claim: 作者公开勘误:2026-07-27 发现 issue 链接组 vs 仅描述组对比因 pandas `== True` 误用漏掉 2,891/25,209(11.5%)个 PR(恰是 issue 引用最多的 PR);修正后 issue 链接组 N 由 10,190→13,081,中位质量 49→50。作者称未影响任何假设检验。
claims.quote: That is 2,891 of 25,209 scored PRs (11.5%) — and not a random 11.5%.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026-07-27, CORRECTIONS.md, delivery-gap-research 仓库
claims.notes: 正面信号(透明勘误、复现包 CC-BY 4.0,Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19415187);同时说明分析管线存在过实质性编码错误,验证阶段应抽查其他脚本。

claims.claim: 本线现场核验发现处理变量的误判:在作者公开的 master-prs.csv 中,被归入「项目 ticket ID(PROJ-123)」的 5,112 个非 bot spec'd PR 里,至少 1,161 个(占该类 22.7%、占全部 spec'd 4.8%)匹配的是普通连字符词而非工单号,如 ID-BASED(16)、LLM-GENERATED(15)、CPU-ONLY(15)、UUID-BASED(14)、ESM-ONLY(11);带数字的部分也混有 GLM-/LLM-/PEP- 等前缀。
claims.source_title: 本线复跑:Hill 复现数据 master-prs.csv(commit a23d38a),spec_source 字段分类统计
claims.notes: 现场核验(本线自行计算,非作者陈述)。论文称已过滤 RFC-/CVE-/GPT- 等误报,但过滤不完整。此类误判多为非差异性噪声,倾向把效应拉向零——与「零结果」方向一致,是审计席应计入的偏倚来源;规模约 5%,单独不足以翻转结论。

claims.claim: Grafana 仓库 .gitignore 明文排除 Spec Kit 文件,Airflow 与 Spark 排除 .kiro/——印证 Hill 所说「这些工具的产出被刻意留在版本库外,任何基于工件的测量都看不见」。
claims.quote: # Spec-kit files shouldn't be committed without a major design process
claims.source_title: grafana/grafana .gitignore(HEAD 2026-11-10);apache/airflow、apache/spark .gitignore
claims.notes: 现场核验:三仓库 HEAD 均仍含该规则(Grafana 第 287–288 行 '.specs';Airflow '# Kiro' '.kiro/';Spark '.kiro/')。含义:仓库普查(ADOPT 线)会系统性低估 SDD 工具使用。

claims.claim: Hill 对 SDD 学术文献的引用链审查:Piskala(2026)称「对照研究显示错误最多减少 50%」,所引 Red Hat 博客与 InfoQ 文章均无任何对照研究或定量数据;Marri(2026)报告的 73% 安全缺陷下降来自单项目、同一开发者先后实现两组条件。
claims.quote: Piskala \cite{piskala2026} claims ``controlled studies showing error reductions of up to 50\%,'' citing a Red Hat Developer blog post \cite{naszcyniec2025} and an InfoQ article \cite{griffin2026}; neither contains any controlled study, experiment, or quantitative data
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 此为 Hill 的二手判断,本线未能回到 Piskala/Red Hat/InfoQ/Marri 原文核对(arxiv.org 被网络策略拦截)——交 PRO/MEASURE 线或验证阶段核。'50%' 若出现在正方叙事中,应按疑似无源数字处理。

claims.claim: Hill 对 Eberhardt 的转述有失真:称 Spec Kit「约慢十倍、产出数千行 markdown 却仍是有 bug 的代码」,而 Eberhardt 原文说 Spec Kit 代码质量「just fine」,只有一个「简单明显」的 bug(变量未从数据存储填充,3 行修复)。
claims.quote: Eberhardt found Spec Kit roughly ten times slower than iterative development, producing thousands of lines of specification markdown that still resulted in buggy code \cite{scottlogic2025}.
claims.source_title: Brenn Hill, 2026, Specification Artifacts in Open-Source Pull Request Workflows Do Not Reduce Defects: An Empirical Test of Spec-Driven Development Claims, ESEM 2026 (LIPIcs vol.394, SEIP track); 全文读自作者公开仓库 github.com/brennhill/delivery-gap-research esem-latex/main.tex(commit a23d38a, 2026-07-27)
claims.notes: 对照 Scott Logic 原文 'the code quality created when following Spec Kit was just fine, but the simple and obvious bug threw me a little';kartlog 提交 8292058e 为 +3/−2 行。'buggy code' 属夸大,转述保真问题。

claims.claim: Böckeler 用 Kiro 修一个小 bug(与她此前测 Codex 用的同一个 bug):需求文档把它变成 4 个「user story」共 16 条验收标准,她称流程「像用大锤砸坚果」。
claims.quote: When I asked Kiro to fix a small bug (it was the same one I used in the past to try Codex), it quickly became clear that the workflow was like using a sledgehammer to crack a nut. The requirements document turned this small bug into 4 “user stories” with a total of 16 acceptance criteria
claims.source_title: Birgitta Böckeler (Thoughtworks), 2025-10-15, Understanding Spec-Driven-Development: Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl, martinfowler.com
claims.notes: martinfowler.com 被网络策略拦截;正文取自 3 份独立的网页剪藏(GitHub: giwankim/obsidian-vault、salomao-santos/letramento-de-ia、danielcamargo/second-brain),关键句在三份中逐字一致。作者为 Thoughtworks 员工(Thoughtworks 卖咨询,不卖 SDD 工具)。 n=1 次运行、2025-10 的 Kiro 版本(Kiro 2025-11 才 GA,后续版本可能已改 bugfix 流程,交 VENDOR 线);未给墙钟/token 数。 quote 为页面渲染文本(剪藏中括号内为超链接锚文本,已去除 markdown 链接标记)。

claims.claim: Böckeler 用 spec-kit 做一个相当于「3–5 点故事」的棕地功能(基于现有看板的汇总弹窗),产出的 markdown 文件多到她觉得对问题规模而言过度;文件彼此重复、也与现有代码重复,冗长乏味。
claims.quote: spec-kit created a LOT of markdown files for me to review. They were repetitive, both with each other, and with the code that already existed. Some contained code already. Overall they were just very verbose and tedious to review.
claims.source_title: Birgitta Böckeler (Thoughtworks), 2025-10-15, Understanding Spec-Driven-Development: Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl, martinfowler.com
claims.notes: martinfowler.com 被网络策略拦截;正文取自 3 份独立的网页剪藏(GitHub: giwankim/obsidian-vault、salomao-santos/letramento-de-ia、danielcamargo/second-brain),关键句在三份中逐字一致。作者为 Thoughtworks 员工(Thoughtworks 卖咨询,不卖 SDD 工具)。 无文件数/行数/时间的定量记录。

claims.claim: Böckeler 结论之一:宁可审代码也不愿审这些 markdown 文件;有效的 SDD 工具需要很好的 spec 审阅体验。
claims.quote: To be honest, I’d rather review code than all these markdown files. An effective SDD tool would have to provide a very good spec review experience.
claims.source_title: Birgitta Böckeler (Thoughtworks), 2025-10-15, Understanding Spec-Driven-Development: Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl, martinfowler.com
claims.notes: martinfowler.com 被网络策略拦截;正文取自 3 份独立的网页剪藏(GitHub: giwankim/obsidian-vault、salomao-santos/letramento-de-ia、danielcamargo/second-brain),关键句在三份中逐字一致。作者为 Thoughtworks 员工(Thoughtworks 卖咨询,不卖 SDD 工具)。

claims.claim: Böckeler 观察到 agent 不遵守 spec:spec-kit 计划阶段的 research 把现有类描述记下,agent 却把这些描述当新规格、重新生成一遍造成重复;也见到 agent 过度执行 constitution 条款。
claims.quote: But ultimately the agent ignored the notes that these were descriptions of existing classes, it just took them as a new specification and generated them all over again, creating duplicates.
claims.source_title: Birgitta Böckeler (Thoughtworks), 2025-10-15, Understanding Spec-Driven-Development: Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl, martinfowler.com
claims.notes: martinfowler.com 被网络策略拦截;正文取自 3 份独立的网页剪藏(GitHub: giwankim/obsidian-vault、salomao-santos/letramento-de-ia、danielcamargo/second-brain),关键句在三份中逐字一致。作者为 Thoughtworks 员工(Thoughtworks 卖咨询,不卖 SDD 工具)。

claims.claim: Böckeler 把 spec-as-source(Tessl)与 MDD(模型驱动开发)类比:MDD 在业务应用中从未普及,处于尴尬的抽象层、开销与约束过大;LLM 去掉了可解析 DSL 与代码生成器的成本,但代价是非确定性,担心 spec-anchored/spec-as-source 会同时继承两者的缺点:不灵活且非确定。
claims.quote: I wonder if spec-as-source, and even spec-anchoring, might end up with the downsides of both MDD and LLMs: Inflexibility *and* non-determinism.
claims.source_title: Birgitta Böckeler (Thoughtworks), 2025-10-15, Understanding Spec-Driven-Development: Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl, martinfowler.com
claims.notes: martinfowler.com 被网络策略拦截;正文取自 3 份独立的网页剪藏(GitHub: giwankim/obsidian-vault、salomao-santos/letramento-de-ia、danielcamargo/second-brain),关键句在三份中逐字一致。作者为 Thoughtworks 员工(Thoughtworks 卖咨询,不卖 SDD 工具)。 「MDD never took off for business applications」为作者亲历判断,无采用率数据——交 HIST 线用调查数据核。

claims.claim: Böckeler 并不否定 spec-first:她本人常先写某种 spec 给 agent,认为 spec-first 原则「在许多情况下肯定有价值」;但「spec-driven development」一词定义不清、已语义稀释,有人把 spec 当作「详细 prompt」的同义词。
claims.quote: So the general principle of spec-first is definitely valuable in many situations
claims.source_title: Birgitta Böckeler (Thoughtworks), 2025-10-15, Understanding Spec-Driven-Development: Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl, martinfowler.com
claims.notes: martinfowler.com 被网络策略拦截;正文取自 3 份独立的网页剪藏(GitHub: giwankim/obsidian-vault、salomao-santos/letramento-de-ia、danielcamargo/second-brain),关键句在三份中逐字一致。作者为 Thoughtworks 员工(Thoughtworks 卖咨询,不卖 SDD 工具)。 反方阵营常被简化为「Böckeler 反对 SDD」——不准确,她批评的是重型工具流程,不是先写 spec。

claims.claim: Eberhardt 用 Spec Kit(GitHub Copilot + Claude Sonnet 4.5)重建其业余应用 KartLog 中一个被他删除的约 1,000 行功能(赛道 CRUD):第一增量 agent 运行 33m30s、产出 689 行代码、2,577 行 markdown、人工审阅约 3.5 小时;其中 Plan 一步产出 2,067 行 markdown(444 行模块契约、395 行数据模型、285 行计划、500 行 quickstart、406 行 research)。
claims.quote:
* 33m30 - of agent execution time
* 689 loc
* 2,577 lines of markdown
* 3.5 hrs review time
claims.source_title: Colin Eberhardt (Scott Logic CTO), 2025-11-26, Putting Spec Kit Through Its Paces: Radical Idea or Reinvented Waterfall?, Scott Logic blog
claims.notes: blog.scottlogic.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 Scott Logic 官方博客源码仓库 github.com/ScottLogic/blog _posts/2025-11-26-...markdown(一手源文件)。 现场核验(kartlog git 历史):删除提交 e2c31dab −1,069 行;spec 提交 cf299c7a +230 行 md;plan 提交 66763b00 +2,067 行 md;实现提交 ba5ef7c4 +689 行;constitution 161 行——均与文中一致。但 Tasks 一节的统计被误复制成 Plan 的数字(实际 tasks 提交 +312 行),且 161+230+2,067+312=2,770 ≠ 文中合计 2,577。审阅时间为自报、未计时工具。n=1、作者重建的是自己已写过的功能。

claims.claim: 同一功能用 Eberhardt 惯用的小增量迭代提示:agent 8 分钟、约 1,000 行代码、零 markdown、15 分钟代码审阅、9 分钟功能测试与小修;他据此称不用 SDD 时自己「大约快十倍」,且实现无 bug。
claims.quote: The simple fact is I am a lot more productive without SDD, around ten times faster.
claims.source_title: Colin Eberhardt (Scott Logic CTO), 2025-11-26, Putting Spec Kit Through Its Paces: Radical Idea or Reinvented Waterfall?, Scott Logic blog
claims.notes: blog.scottlogic.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 Scott Logic 官方博客源码仓库 github.com/ScottLogic/blog _posts/2025-11-26-...markdown(一手源文件)。 对照不对称:文中未说明迭代版计时来自原始构建还是重建(一份二手综述称是「第二次构建一个他已熟悉的功能」);迭代臂约 1,000 行覆盖两个增量(含 GPS),SDD 臂两增量合计 agent 57m、约 5.5h 审阅。按文中数字算倍数约 7.6×(仅增量一)~12×(两增量)。'十倍'是作者自估,非受控实验。

claims.claim: Eberhardt 认为 Spec Kit 产出的 markdown 大量重复且是「伪上下文」(如为「戴手套操作」编造 UI 理由),Spec Kit 消耗大量 agent 时间写 markdown,最终并未带来更好的产品。
claims.quote: Furthermore, Spec Kit burnt through a lot of agent time creating markdown files that ultimately didn’t result in a better product.
claims.source_title: Colin Eberhardt (Scott Logic CTO), 2025-11-26, Putting Spec Kit Through Its Paces: Radical Idea or Reinvented Waterfall?, Scott Logic blog
claims.notes: blog.scottlogic.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 Scott Logic 官方博客源码仓库 github.com/ScottLogic/blog _posts/2025-11-26-...markdown(一手源文件)。 未测 token 数(文中说要列 token 但实际未列)。

claims.claim: Eberhardt 为 SDD 留了余地:承认可能是自己用法不对、不确定该用于多大的问题,且自己可能不是目标用户(他是亲自审代码的架构师),Spec Kit 也许是给 vibe coder/产品负责人/不写代码的人用的。
claims.quote: Furthermore, I am willing to entertain the possibility that I am simply just using it wrong!
claims.source_title: Colin Eberhardt (Scott Logic CTO), 2025-11-26, Putting Spec Kit Through Its Paces: Radical Idea or Reinvented Waterfall?, Scott Logic blog
claims.notes: blog.scottlogic.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 Scott Logic 官方博客源码仓库 github.com/ScottLogic/blog _posts/2025-11-26-...markdown(一手源文件)。

claims.claim: Zaninotto 引用的例子:某开发者用 Spec Kit 为一个工时追踪应用「显示当前日期」,产出 8 个文件、1,300 行文本;另一 Kiro 例子为 Atomic CRM 加「referred by」字段。他列出 7 项缺陷(上下文盲、Markdown 泛滥、系统性官僚、伪敏捷、双重代码审阅、虚假安全感、收益递减)。
claims.quote: Here’s an example using GitHub’s spec-kit, where a developer wanted to display the current date on a time-tracking app, resulting in 8 files and 1,300 lines of text
claims.source_title: François Zaninotto (Marmelab CEO), 2025-11-12, Spec-Driven Development: The Waterfall Strikes Back, Marmelab blog
claims.notes: marmelab.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 HN 文章存档 github.com/artur-shlyapnikov/hn-distill data/raw/articles/45935763.md(整页抓取副本)。作者是 Marmelab CEO,推广自己命名的 'Natural Language Development' 路线——立场方利益:不卖 SDD 工具,但有替代方法论品牌。 现场核验 adguernier/frequentito PR#42:specs/002-display-current-date/ 下确为 8 个文件,但新增 1,865 行(非 1,300);生产代码约 126 行(CurrentDate.tsx 101 + page.tsx 6 + types 19),另有测试/stories 605 行;PR 还含 Spec Kit 脚手架 .specify/ 等,总计 +6,151 行。'1,300' 口径不明(可能是早期快照或只计部分文件)。Marmelab 本身未做任何计时或计量实验。 quote 为页面渲染文本(剪藏中括号内为超链接锚文本,已去除 markdown 链接标记)。

claims.claim: Zaninotto 称 SDD 让开发者 80% 时间在读而非思考,且 agent 并不总遵守 spec:Kiro 例子中 agent 把「验证实现」任务标为完成却没写一个单元测试,只写了手工测试说明。
claims.quote: In the example above, the agent marked the “verify implementation” task as done without writing a single unit test—it wrote manual testing instructions instead.
claims.source_title: François Zaninotto (Marmelab CEO), 2025-11-12, Spec-Driven Development: The Waterfall Strikes Back, Marmelab blog
claims.notes: marmelab.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 HN 文章存档 github.com/artur-shlyapnikov/hn-distill data/raw/articles/45935763.md(整页抓取副本)。作者是 Marmelab CEO,推广自己命名的 'Natural Language Development' 路线——立场方利益:不卖 SDD 工具,但有替代方法论品牌。 '80%' 为修辞性估计('spending 80% of your time reading instead of thinking'),无测量,不得承重。

claims.claim: Zaninotto 承认 SDD 帮 agent 保持在任务上、偶尔能发现开发者遗漏的边界情况,并称 SDD 在从零起步的新项目中表现好,但随应用增长 spec 越来越失准并拖慢开发,对大型既有代码库「基本不可用」。
claims.quote: SDD shines when starting a new project from scratch, but as the application grows, the specs miss the point more often and slow development. For large existing codebases, SDD is mostly unusable.
claims.source_title: François Zaninotto (Marmelab CEO), 2025-11-12, Spec-Driven Development: The Waterfall Strikes Back, Marmelab blog
claims.notes: marmelab.com 未直接抓取;正文取自 HN 文章存档 github.com/artur-shlyapnikov/hn-distill data/raw/articles/45935763.md(整页抓取副本)。作者是 Marmelab CEO,推广自己命名的 'Natural Language Development' 路线——立场方利益:不卖 SDD 工具,但有替代方法论品牌。 断言无数据支撑。

claims.claim: 社区出现专门检测 Spec Kit「幽灵完成」(tasks.md 中被勾选为完成但从未实现的任务)的扩展 spec-kit-verify-tasks,以五层级联(文件存在、git diff、符号 grep、死代码、语义评估)复核——侧面说明「agent 勾任务≠完成任务」是被反复遇到的问题。
claims.quote: A **phantom completion** is a task marked `[X]` as done that was never actually implemented.
claims.source_title: datastone-inc, 2026, spec-kit-verify-tasks README
claims.notes: 工具作者自述,无发生率数据;存在性证据,非频率证据。
